vectors.name: delegation
vectors.why: An owner signs once, for a year at most, which key may do what and how far.

vectors.name: delegation_from_when_rules_were_renewed
vectors.why: One signed before rules lasted until replaced also let its delegate renew them. It still verifies, and that leave does nothing now.

vectors.name: delegation_by_a_passkey
vectors.why: An owner whose key never leaves their passkey store signs it with one touch.

vectors.name: delegation_by_another_owner
vectors.why: Only this owner's key can let anyone sign for them.

vectors.name: delegation_by_the_agent_key
vectors.why: A fooled agent can't delegate to itself.

vectors.name: older_delegation_after_a_newer_one
vectors.why: Signet holds one delegation and takes only a newer one, so one handed back can't take the place of the one the owner's rules name.

vectors.name: delegate_key_is_the_agent_key
vectors.why: One key, one job: the agent's key signing as a delegate would make its own steps look like the owner's yes.

vectors.name: delegate_key_is_the_owner_key
vectors.why: Likewise the owner's own key.

vectors.name: delegation_at_full_auto
vectors.why: A delegate says yes only within caps, never to everything.

vectors.name: delegation_to_approve_at_ask_me
vectors.why: At ask me every yes is the owner's.

vectors.name: delegation_for_more_than_a_year
vectors.why: A key the owner forgets ends within a year.

vectors.name: delegation_with_may_out_of_order
vectors.why: Sorted with no repeats, so one delegation has one encoding.

vectors.name: delegation_for_another_agent
vectors.why: It's for one agent.

vectors.name: delegation_in_another_field_order
vectors.why: Fields in their one order, so one delegation has one encoding and every reader parses it alike.

vectors.name: delegation_with_caps_out_of_order
vectors.why: Caps sorted by type and by field, as in a yes, so one delegation has one encoding.

vectors.name: delegation_over
vectors.why: One past its end lets nobody sign anything for the owner.

vectors.name: delegation_dated_ahead
vectors.why: It can't start later than the owner meant.

vectors.name: delegation_from_before_a_recovery
vectors.why: A recovery ends every delegation the key it replaced signed, so a thief holding that key, or what it signed, gets nothing.

vectors.name: delegation_by_a_stand_in_owner
vectors.why: A stand-in's key is on the agent's own machine, so a fooled agent could delegate its owner's yes to itself.

vectors.name: delegated_yes
vectors.why: A yes to a confirm whose every value has a cap and fits it, which any reader can check against the caps.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_over_the_cap
vectors.why: A fooled agent holding the delegate key still can't say yes past the cap.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_in_another_unit
vectors.why: A cap in dollars says nothing about euros.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_to_an_uncapped_value
vectors.why: A value the owner never capped waits for them.

vectors.name: delegated_no
vectors.why: A no is the owner's to say: a delegate's could only stop what they wanted.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_to_a_cancel
vectors.why: Only a confirm.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_after_the_delegation_ended
vectors.why: Signed after the delegation ended.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_without_leave_to_approve
vectors.why: The owner only let it renew rules, back when they were renewed.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_under_another_owners_delegation
vectors.why: Only this owner's delegation.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_by_another_key
vectors.why: Only the key the owner named.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_by_the_agent_key_named_as_delegate
vectors.why: The agent's own key can't be the delegate.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_outlasting_the_delegation
vectors.why: A yes dated inside the delegation but ending after it could be carried by a step sent once the delegation had ended, to a request opened since.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_in_another_field_order
vectors.why: What a delegate key signs has one encoding, as a fooled agent can read that key and sign any other.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_with_terms_out_of_order
vectors.why: The fields in its terms too.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_to_a_type_not_capped
vectors.why: A type with no values the owner didn't name in the caps gets no yes: they said which types it may agree to.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_to_a_named_type_with_no_values
vectors.why: One the owner named, with nothing to cap, does.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_from_before_a_recovery
vectors.why: Arriving after the owner recovered, it's under a delegation the old key signed, which the recovery ended.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_from_before_a_recovery_read_back
vectors.why: Read back in a chain, it was taken when it came, as the owner's own yes from then is.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_by_a_stand_in_owner
vectors.why: Nothing an unconfirmed owner's key signs is an owner's yes, a delegate's included.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_in_a_chain_read_back_after_a_recovery
vectors.why: A chain is read back as it was taken: a delegate's yes from before the owner recovered still completes it.

vectors.name: delegated_yes_in_an_outcome_after_a_recovery
vectors.why: An outcome is read back too, so a delegate's yes from before the owner recovered still proves it.

vectors.name: stand_in_owners_yes_in_a_chain
vectors.why: A stand-in's key is on the agent's own machine, so its plain yes moves nothing, read back too.
